What Multidex Plus includes

Multidex Plus unlocks the app's extras: shiny artwork with an encounter rate you control, trading cards and Pokémon cries, and visual themes, search placement and more. The Plus screen in the app lists everything included.

Browsing, offline entries and the rest of the Pokédex stay free. Monthly and annual plans include the same features.

Price, billing and renewal

Prices are shown in the app in your local currency and confirmed by Google Play before you pay. There is no free trial or introductory price, and annual plans are charged once a year.

Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. To cancel, open Google Play, tap your profile picture, then Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Multidex. Cancelling stops the next renewal; Plus stays active until the end of the current period.

Google Play handles refunds under its own policies. For help, email us with your Google Play order number, never your card details.

Sign-in, restore and changing devices

You need to be signed in to subscribe, so Plus belongs to your Multidex account. Signing in to the same account on another device, or choosing Restore purchases, brings Plus back.

Restoring also depends on the Google Play account used for the purchase; purchases can't always be moved between different store accounts.

Switching or logging out of an account removes that account's Plus access on the device until you sign back in.

Deleting your account and billing help

Deleting your Multidex account doesn't cancel a Google Play subscription. Cancel it in Google Play first, then delete the account.

Questions about billing: kunal26das@gmail.com.
